assessment.rationale: A human contributor reports scoped firsthand local use. The retained technical review meets Tier 3 requirements; Tier 2 gaps remain in Darwin execution. Ongoing maintainer use with two qualifying open-source consumer projects is not established.

evaluation.summary: All 35 executable checks.x86_64-linux attributes evaluate and realize successfully at bd48bb6b1c1fe893899a301e5c55fc7cc8e92310. Exact derivations, native outputs and NAR hashes are in the packet; native aarch64-linux CI independently succeeds.

goodTests.summary: Executable checks cover Ruby unit tests, tampered/stale/missing/malformed/external locks, a workspace app, local path gem, library tests, gem packaging and executable loading. Lobsters loads Rails and libvips from its offline bundle. Historical compiled-extension consumers and SDK composition exercise real ABI-sensitive behavior.

linux.summary: Native aarch64-linux CI builds the required sample/check derivations successfully at the exact reviewed revision; local x86_64-linux checks also realize successfully. Neither result is cross-evaluation.

darwin.summary: The inspected .github/workflows/check.yml and successful native jobs cover ubuntu-latest and ubuntu-24.04-arm only. The flake declares aarch64-darwin, which is not execution. No successful native Darwin sample derivation/SDK/output receipt is available; this Linux review host cannot execute it.

oneVersion.summary: Actual native sample execution demonstrates Ruby 3.4.11 and 4.0.9; historical Ruby 2.5.8 and 1.8.7-p374 with Bundler 1.17.3. Scope is the exact executed version point(s), not a version range.

nonEolVersions.summary: The successful independent Lobsters sample executes Ruby 4.0.9 and the lock-selected Bundler 4.0.3. Ruby 4.0 is in normal maintenance. The official RubyGems compatibility policy identifies the current Bundler 4.0 series, requiring Ruby >=3.2 and RubyGems >=3.4.1; Ruby 4.0 ships a matching RubyGems/Bundler 4.0 pair. This is an actually tested maintained manager/runtime pair. Ruby 3.4.11 is also demonstrated by fixture-app; missing maintained Ruby 3.3 does not invalidate this bounded judgment. No untested version or all-patch range is claimed.

manySamples.summary: Lobsters is one independent upstream application. App/library/submodule and historical-greeting fixtures give meaningful scenario coverage, but are authored here and do not establish many independent upstream application builds.

longCompatibility.summary: Successful x86_64-linux check/consumer derivations execute Ruby 1.8.7-p374 with RubyGems 2.6.14/Bundler 1.17.3 and a compiled json 1.8.6 extension; another exact tuple uses Ruby 2.5.8/Bundler 1.17.3. Ordinary consumers load the projected gem and compiled extension. Together with Ruby 3.4.11/4.0.9 sample execution, these are substantive historical compatibility points spanning old and modern toolchains. Intermediate versions and Darwin history are not inferred.
